messages:
kai: quick sync 1 min 1 updated autoscale card in Figma: pool-select + min/max stepper. Need copy + a11y checks.
rachel: saw it. two asks: 1) pool switch modal should warn its staged, not instant. 2) fallback wording needs to be friendlier.
omar: pool modal suggestion: header 'Switch route to pool', body 'New requests will be sent to FriendlyPool (friendly-1). Existing requests may continue on the current pool while connections drain.' CTAs: 'Cancel' / 'Confirm switch'.
tia: on fallback copy: short toast: 'Burst unavailable  using backup capacity.' expanded: 'Burst capacity unavailable; traffic temporarily rerouted to Pool Beta to preserve latency SLOs.'
a11y-bot: accessibility flags: stepper must be a proper spinbutton with aria-valuemin/max/now, buttons for +/- must be <button>s, focus ring token applied, and toast should use role=status + aria-atomic=true.
kai: also want an undo snackbar for pool switches (90s). engineering can support a best-effort rollback API.
omar: agree. show 'Revert pool switch' in snackbar. if rollback fails show clear error and link to activity log.
tia: SLO slider: add live cost preview chip that updates on drag. aria-live=polite for the chip and concise text 'Cost: +$0.04/hr'.
a11y-bot: confirm tooltip for the SLO slider must be keyboard focusable and referenced by aria-describedby.
kai: thanks all. rachel, tia will update Figma with modal copy, toast variants, snackbar, and a11y notes. I'll follow up for implementation scheduling. :white_check_mark:
